column1: # The class table of the gate-* recipes (tools/gate_class.py reads it; the class stage of `just affected` reads it later).
#   recipe  the justfile's gate-* recipe name
#   class   common (family-agnostic: a synthetic input or a shape-generic owner), family (one family's own weights or
#           code) or tooling (harness, static, fixture writer, corpus)
#   family  the registry's canonical name (tools/arch-registry.tsv column 1, the first name of a comma list) or a
#           declared non-arch group (gemma4a, gemma4v, minicpmv47, qwen38d); empty for a common or a tooling row
#   owners  the owners it tests, a '+' list of names in tools/owners.tsv, or '-'
